name: Razor Saint
presence: Razor Saint paces the shallow end in a coat of reflector tape, two blades, no hurry.

presenceWhen.text: Razor Saint sits on the pool edge counting his teeth, or what you left of the arrangement.

greeting: Door tax: twenty-two scrip, or a ceramic knife you can respect, or the other conversation, which is a fight.

tax.gist: Twenty-two scrip, or the knife. Killing you also works and is worse for both your evenings. The red grid behind you is municipal, not part of your tax.

grid.gist: Red light on the south stair. It eats tapes, not blood. The ghost in the mast hands those tapes out if they bring her a glass eye.

wafer.gist: You keep a black wafer in your coat. Juniper sells its twin and calls it a future. They get yours only if you stop being alive.

trades.gist: You tested the ceramic knife on your thumb. Tax paid; the stair is theirs. The grid is not your problem and not your mercy.

bribe.gist: You counted the twenty-two scrip with insulting slowness and stepped off the stair. Tell them to go be municipal.
bribe.alreadyGist: The tax is paid. Tell them to stop showing you money; you might remember you like it.

combat.onDeathSay: Razor Saint folds into the shallow end, reflector tape still trying to be glorious. The stair is yours. So is whatever the coat was hiding.
